Pattern: when streaming with mode=json output and function calling enabled, the client receives text chunks where the 'name' and 'arguments' fields are sometimes split. Example: chunk1 ends with '{"name": "lookup_ticket", "arguments": {"id"', chunk2 continues ' : "TCK-123"}}'. Their JS parser uses incremental JSON.parse on each chunk (unsafe). SE note: recommend either use streaming-delimited events (event: json) or adapt client to buffer until valid JSON; server-side can also emit top-level framing tokens.
